faq_heading: King George Corridor houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in King George Corridor. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

King George Corridor, South Surrey and White Rock: 85 houses listed at the end of September 2026 and 8 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 3 of 9 South Surrey and White Rock communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in King George Corridor fell from 87 in June to 85 in September (−2.3%), and 39 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 14.2% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 600 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in King George Corridor?
King George Corridor also had 131 condos and townhomes listed and 27 sold in September, against 85 houses listed. The King George Corridor condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: King George Corridor home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

71 houses sold in King George Corridor with a median price of $1,345,000 (the middle half sold between $1,179,950 and $1,515,000), taking a median of 21 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 15% sold above list. They had a median $561 per square foot, a median year built of 1988 and a median lot of 7,155 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in King George Corridor?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 85 houses listed in King George Corridor. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is King George Corridor a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in King George Corridor had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in King George Corridor from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 39 houses sold in King George Corridor over those 4 months, out of 240 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in King George Corridor?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in King George Corridor sell for?
faq.a: 71 houses sold in King George Corridor between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,345,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in King George Corridor?
faq.a: The median was 21 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.7% of the last list price (15% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
